# by the spike on 2026-11-01. Only the notifications of the native side input
# characteristic and the steps of the capture script are kept; nothing from the
# flash, the command replies or the connection (serial number, addresses).
#
# line:  <ms> side 63 <63 hex bytes>   a report, ms since the capture started
#        <ms> MARK <step> start|end     a step the owner was asked to do
#
# The steps "button-x" and "button-y" were pressed swapped by the owner: during
# "button-x" they pressed Y, and during "button-y" they pressed X. The data is
# right and the labels are not (golden_test.go expects exactly that).
# "button-stick-click" moves the stick as well, and releases a little late into
# the next step.
